result.note: Tests the Delhi High Court's September 2026 ruling on job protection after maternity leave and its direction to the Centre.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the Delhi High Court ruled on the rights of women returning from maternity leave. Consider the following statements about the ruling:
items: Women returning from maternity leave must get their old job or an equivalent one.
The court directed the Centre to draft protective rules within six months.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are correct. On 4 September 2026 the Delhi High Court held that a woman returning from maternity leave is entitled to her old job or an equivalent one. It also ordered the Centre to frame protective rules within six months.
questions.source: The Delhi High Court ruled that women returning from maternity leave must get their old job or an equivalent one, ordering the Centre to draft protective rules within six months.
